title: Pay Security
description: Manage payment security policies including API anti-replay and risk control.

risk.title: Payment Risk Control
risk.description: Blacklist risk control: block orders or log only.

riskEnabled.label: Risk Control Master Switch
riskEnabled.desc: When enabled, the payment flow performs blacklist checks; when disabled, all risk checks are skipped.

riskBlockBeforePay.label: Block Order on Hit
riskBlockBeforePay.desc: When enabled, blacklist hits before payment will reject the order; when disabled, hits are only logged without blocking.

riskCheckAfterPay.label: Post-Pay Hit Logging
riskCheckAfterPay.desc: When enabled, hits are recorded after successful payment for post-event analysis, without affecting funds.
